description: r.main is cancelled (Deadline) at 0, so t.0's child region t.0.r1 closes at once while t.0 sleeps; t.1 then opens a region of its own. When t.0 wakes, its spawn into t.0.r1 is refused as ASX_E_REGION_CLOSED, as Rust refuses a spawn into a recently closed region. C used to recycle t.0.r1's slot for t.1's region, so the spawn saw ASX_E_STALE_HANDLE (fuzz gen-26-180, minimized).
